# -- tv_research.100 -----------------------------------------------------
tv_research.100 = {
	type = country_event
	title = tv_research.100.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm < 20 } }
				desc = tv_research.100.d_tier1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm >= 20 adm < 50 } }
				desc = tv_research.100.d_tier2
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm >= 50 adm < 80 } }
				desc = tv_research.100.d_tier3
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm >= 80 } }
				desc = tv_research.100.d_tier4
			}
		}
	}
	outcome = good

	trigger = {
		has_variable = tv_academy_io_member
		var:tv_research_phase ?= 2
		has_variable = tv_academy_leader_char
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_research_scientist }
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_research.100.a
		tv_change_research_d_progress_effect = { value = 5 }
	}
}

# -- tv_research.111 -----------------------------------------------------
tv_research.111 = {
	type = country_event
	title = tv_research.111.t
	desc = tv_research.111.d
	outcome = bad

	trigger = {
		has_variable = tv_academy_io_member
		var:tv_research_phase ?= 2
		has_variable = tv_academy_leader_char
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm >= 20 }
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { adm < 50 }
		any_cabinet_character = { count > 0 }
	}

	immediate = {
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_research_scientist }
		random_cabinet_character = {
			save_scope_as = tv_research_cabinet
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_research.111.a
		scope:tv_research_cabinet = {
		  add_character_modifier = {
		    modifier = tv_research_cabinet_member_distracted
		    years = 1
		    mode = replace
		  }
		}
	}
}

	immediate = {
		var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { save_scope_as = tv_research_scientist }
	}

	option = {
		name = tv_research.124.a
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	}
}
